item.title: Deep dive: SBOM export in Acme Registry
item.content:encoded:
Acme Registry now exports SBOMs in CycloneDX and SPDX formats for every artifact.

The export runs automatically on upload and is attached as build metadata. Teams can query SBOMs through the API, filter by license and vulnerability, and push them to downstream tools. This closes a long-standing gap compared with other registries, and Acme says it will extend the feature to container images and ML models next quarter, with signed attestations and policy gates arriving later this year for enterprise customers.
